data.name: Muarrifi
data.gender_notes: Muarrifi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who rectifies, corrects, sets right
data.long_meaning: One who rectifies and corrects, bringing things back to their rightful place or state. This name carries the deep spiritual meaning of being a guide and leader towards the righteous path. The name Muarrifi carries the meaning “One who rectifies, corrects, sets right” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muarrifi usually hope their child will grow to embody one who rectifies, corrects, sets right and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Muarrifi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who rectifies, corrects, sets right.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muarrifi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
